title: The Devil's Sea of Japan
hook: Why do ships vanish in Japan's Devil's Sea?
headline: Mystery of the Pacific's Bermuda Triangle

beats.label: THE CASE
beats.line: In 1952 the research vessel Kaiyō-Maru disappeared; reports of strange lights near the Devil's Sea were later mentioned.

beats.label: CLUE 1
beats.line: Two years later, a US Navy patrol plane vanished after radar lost contact.

beats.label: CLUE 2
beats.line: In 1973 a fishing boat crew claimed a massive whirlpool swallowed their vessel.

beats.label: THE TWIST
beats.line: Recent sonar surveys detected anomalous magnetic fields matching the area's volcanic activity.

end.line: What could be pulling vessels into the abyss?

description: A brief look at the mysterious disappearances in Japan's Devil's Sea.
